purpose: Find sustained processing backlog under increased balanced input; no mitigation
stage_policy: Run one stage and inspect it before selecting a next stage; stop increasing once informative overload is found.

required_observations: Positive acknowledged-arrival minus completion rate during the same windows
Backlog across multiple partitions with recorded ownership
No unresolved sends, evidence loss, conflicting identities or unexplained observation gaps
Producer/broker/node measurements support consumer-stage capacity as the limiting factor
Inspect the full backlog trace for persistent growth; boundary median comparisons alone are insufficient

stop_conditions.local_free_space_rule: At least 4 times projected raw-run bytes plus 8 GiB reserve before each stage
immediate: Pod OOM/restarts or impending storage exhaustion
stop_conditions.invalid_monitoring_scope: During evaluation; require valid coverage before evaluation begins. Backlog/storage/error limits also apply during warm-up.

enforcement: Reviewed run by run. The standard runner enforces duration/drain; these extra thresholds currently require operator monitoring and explicit stop. No automatic overload-threshold guard is claimed.
constraints: Do not change processing cost, replicas, partition count or rate during a frozen run.
Do not run all rates blindly via a sweep command.
An early-stopped trial is labelled interrupted/threshold-limited; preserve all available evidence.
If all three stages remain stable, review the measured bottleneck before choosing more pressure.
This is short calibration, not the proposal comparison or five-repetition protocol.
Achieving below 95% of target flags workload tracking for investigation; it does not by itself prove that consumers are not overloaded.
